portfolio_controls.acceptance_rule: A return must contain a typed lemma, construction, counterexample, or obstruction with equations, exact assumptions, failure test, open gap, and novelty fingerprint; summaries and confidence statements do not count.
portfolio_controls.independence_limit: The two audits used isolated prompt context but share the Codex runtime, model family, repository, and coordinator. They are mechanism-diverse search inputs, not independent corroborating evidence.
portfolio_controls.duplicate_policy: Retire or redirect a return whose novelty fingerprint repeats without removing a named gap.

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Bounded conditional log-Laplace action map, reverse-kernel conditional expectation, and quotient by additive constants.
mechanism_families.representation: Open L-infinity action charts, Lp normalized tangents, and L-infinity/R1 with oscillation norm.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Conditional Jensen contraction and total conditional variance are invariant; topology-free relevance is obstructed by the circle witness.
obligations: Prove analytic map bounds and both Frechet derivatives.
Fix a jointly measurable reverse-kernel version.
Separate bounded-sector spectral claims from weighted-space claims.
mechanism_families.bridge: Action-to-score centering connects this family to normalized Fisher tangents, while assembly maps connect it to extensive interactions.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Use an unbounded Lp perturbation with divergent exponential moment, the circle norm witness, identity channel, and two-cycle.
open_gaps: Independent proof reconstruction and exact source mappings.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: bounded normalized actions + conditional log-Laplace/expectation + Jensen and conditional variance + centering bridge + finite positive measure-pair assumptions

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Full finite power-set Hoeffding extraction and assembly in hierarchical zero-mean gauge.
mechanism_families.representation: Direct sum over every nonempty subset A of bounded zero-mean interaction potentials relative to a product reference equivalent to the normalized law.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Exact inversion modulo constants is available at each finite scale; product-reference equivalence is not automatically preserved by arbitrary coarse kernels.
obligations: Prove PE=I and EP=I uniformly for arbitrary finite cardinality without imposing a size ceiling.
Prove product-reference covariance and equivalence separately at every scale.
Carry every generated interaction or a typed residual.
mechanism_families.bridge: P_{l+1} overline(U_l) E_l factors the extensive coupling derivative through the normalized action derivative.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Delete the top-order component; use nonproduct averaging; or push Lebesgue measure through x maps to (x,x), producing a diagonal law singular to every compatible nonatomic product reference.
open_gaps: Characterize admitted kernels that preserve an equivalent product reference.
Control extraction bounds that grow as 3^|V|-1 without claiming a uniform operator constant.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: finite full subset interactions + commuting coordinate projections + hierarchical gauge + exact action-quotient inverse + per-scale product-domination seam

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Place the unital conditional-expectation operator on one weighted sup, Holder, or Orlicz space to seek relevant spectrum without an explicit extensive assembly factor.
mechanism_families.representation: Competing weighted action Banach spaces, including c0(5^n) and periodic C^alpha.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Relevant spectral radius can occur, but the nonlinear logarithmic action map may fail Frechet differentiability and other weights may have infinite spectral radius.
obligations: Prove a vector-space norm and open nonlinear chart.
Prove first and second derivative boundedness, two-sided evidence control, finite spectral radius, and cross-scale norm comparison.
mechanism_families.bridge: Could unify action and relevance only if all nonlinear-chart and evidence obligations close; no such bridge is currently established.
mechanism_families.failure_test: The advance-or-reset weighted witness has U phi=2 phi while small weighted-norm spikes make Q-U non-differentiable at zero.
open_gaps: Existence of a natural weighted Banach chart with nonlinear regularity, finite r(U)>1, and two-sided evidence control.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: weighted unbounded actions + unital transfer operator + spectral growth + nonlinear Frechet obstruction + weighted evidence assumptions

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Realize centered L2 scores by two-sided quadratic DQM paths, lift additively over iid blocks, and project by conditional expectation.
mechanism_families.representation: Centered L2 score tangent spaces and selected smooth statistical-law manifolds.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Every centered L2 tangent is inhabited by the squared-linear density path, but an arbitrary L2 score need not exponentiate to a finite nonlinear action chart.
obligations: Prove normalization and DQM including the sign-change tail.
Retain covariance cross terms outside iid blocks.
Prove selected-family closure and smoothness under pushforward.
mechanism_families.bridge: The centering isometry maps bounded action quotients into scores; extensive score lift supplies the volume factor missing from the bare normalized action derivative.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Drop centering, introduce correlated blocks, or choose an L2 score with divergent moment-generating function.
open_gaps: Gauge and nuisance constraints may restrict the realized tangent subspace.
Selected coarse-family closure must be constructed.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: DQM scores + squared-linear two-sided path + iid additive lift + conditional score projection + no exponential-chart assumption

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Use normalized Gaussian block sums and Mehler conditional expectation to diagonalize the extensive score operator in the Hermite basis.
mechanism_families.representation: L2_0 of N(0,1) with normalized probabilists' Hermite polynomials.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: At the fixed Gaussian law, eigenvalues b^(1-k/2) inhabit all three relevance classes; changing the output law or correlations destroys the same-space iid diagonalization.
obligations: Prove the Mehler identity and Hermite completeness.
Keep the constant mode and centered restriction distinct.
Do not reuse iid eigenvalues for correlated or anisotropic blocks.
mechanism_families.bridge: Provides an exact inhabited realization of the extensive DQM family and a check on generalized-mode normalization.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Fix mean or variance, change the coarse normalization, leave the Gaussian fixed law, or correlate block variables.
open_gaps: Multivariate anisotropic and gauge-mixed extensions require separate diagonalization.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: Gaussian fixed score law + iid sum statistic + Mehler diagonalization + Hermite completeness + explicit relevant/marginal/irrelevant modes

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Treat exact nonlinear scale arrows and their derivatives as an ordered nonautonomous evolution with invariant sections and generalized cross-scale modes.
mechanism_families.representation: Scale-indexed Banach spaces and associated bundles with bounded comparison trivializations only where declared.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Derivative composition is canonical; ordinary eigenvalues, fixed points, and beta subtraction are not typed without reference isomorphisms, and growth is not invariant under superexponential norm distortion.
obligations: Prove identity and ordered composition in every tier.
Require tempered distortion for the full trivialization and its inverse.
Separate discrete finite differences from any continuous scale connection.
mechanism_families.bridge: The exact interaction orbit supplies the derivative base; bundle and Fisher defect cocycles supply compatible geometric modules only after their own composition laws.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Use the identity cocycle with scale norms exp(l^2)|x| or subtract objects in different scale spaces.
open_gaps: The approved design records scalar tempered normalization but must also release-gate complete comparison-trivialization distortion.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: nonautonomous exact orbit + derivative chain rule + invariant sections + tempered reference trivialization + discrete beta typing

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Model each kernel, law map, bundle map, action map, interaction map, score map, and configuration map as a distinct typed arrow and require every square and composition law explicitly.
mechanism_families.representation: Thin scale category into declared categories of standard-Borel kernels, smooth bundles, Banach spaces, and configuration manifolds.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: A sample-space kernel is not a smooth law-manifold or associated-bundle map; a bundle map does not automatically induce a map on section spaces.
obligations: Construct the induced smooth law map.
Prove associated-bundle representative independence.
Prove section projectability or provide a separate configuration construction.
Disambiguate the configuration coarse-map symbol from the existing reference-space endomorphism.
mechanism_families.bridge: Typed commutative diagrams are the interface certificates allowing results from operator, interaction, gauge, and history families to compose.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Break the group-intertwining square or collapse S1 to a point with Q(x)=sin x, which has no descended coarse section.
open_gaps: The approved design uses a configuration symbol already present for a reference-space endomorphism; a recorded design amendment is required before manuscript implementation.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: typed heterogeneous categories + representative descent + commutative squares + section projectability + interface certification

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Use Fisher-isometric represented actions, covariant vertical first jets, smooth Markov law maps, and horizontal-defect accounting.
mechanism_families.representation: Associated statistical bundles with connections, vertical score tangents, fiber Fisher tensors, and connection-relative base semimetrics.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Vertical Fisher loss is positive; the base comparison is positive only when the horizontal defect vanishes, otherwise signed anomaly terms remain.
obligations: Prove Fisher-isometric group actions and smooth equivariant law pushforwards.
Prove the covariant first-jet chain rule and horizontal-defect composition.
Separate set-level orbit descent from smooth quotient geometry.
mechanism_families.bridge: Pulling the vertical conditional-score defect through compatible sections yields the base defect; no direct edge to history semiconjugacy is licensed.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Use a nonisometric scale action, a pushed law outside the selected family, or the trivial-line-bundle horizontal mismatch that reverses the base inequality.
open_gaps: Regular-stratum or quotient hypotheses at nonfree gauge actions.
Actual smooth selected-family closure for each manuscript application.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: associated bundles + Fisher-isometric gauge action + covariant vertical jets + Markov score defect + horizontal anomaly

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Construct strong configuration Fisher manifolds and smooth coarse maps, then prove positive vector-field semiconjugacy and separately compare Fisher speeds.
mechanism_families.representation: Finite-dimensional or declared Banach/Hilbert manifolds of admissible sections with strong metrics and locally Lipschitz VFE vector fields.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Positive semiconjugacy preserves local orientation but can collapse an orbit and does not equate information durations without metric compatibility.
obligations: Choose the configuration category and exact joint or declared product metric.
Construct a smooth noncollapsing coarse map.
Prove semiconjugacy as an equality, not a definition.
State maximal-interval and speed relations.
mechanism_families.bridge: A horizontally conformal submersion plus objective pullback is a sufficient construction yielding semiconjugacy factor equal to the squared dilation.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Use a constant coarse map and zero coarse field, or identity dynamics with metrics dx^2 and 4dx^2.
open_gaps: No configuration manifold, metric, coarse map, or vector-field equality has yet been instantiated in Task 1.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: section configuration manifold + strong Fisher metric + noncollapsing positive semiconjugacy + distinct duration-speed relation + timeless orbit semantics

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Actively attack each universal seam with exact finite witnesses rather than infer closure from finite agreement.
mechanism_families.representation: Finite standard-Borel kernels, explicit Banach-space maps, simple bundles, moving-atom laws, singular Gaussian matrices, and source/type counterexamples.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: One admitted scope-matched counterexample refutes a universal conjunct; failure to find one proves nothing.
obligations: Map every witness to the exact claim assumptions.
Retain conditional replacement theorems after a stronger claim fails.
Do not treat agent agreement or numerical enumeration as proof.
mechanism_families.bridge: Falsifiers set assumption boundaries and redirect constructive families toward the exact missing interface.
mechanism_families.failure_test: The family fails if a purported counterexample violates a target premise or attacks a different quantifier.
open_gaps: Each candidate witness still requires independent reconstruction and artifact-backed certification.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: quantifier-matched finite witnesses + exact type seams + obstruction removal obligations + no absence-as-evidence

convergence_registry.convergence: Both produce conditional expectation, but one differentiates a bounded action chart and the other transports arbitrary L2 DQM scores.
convergence_registry.redirect: Reject attempts to identify their domains; redirect to the exact centering/interface claim.

convergence_registry.convergence: The iid Gaussian family is a concrete realization of the general extensive score lift.
convergence_registry.redirect: Further one-dimensional Gaussian returns must address multivariate, correlated, or gauge-mixed blocks.

convergence_registry.convergence: Reset and circle witnesses both prove norm dependence, while the reset witness additionally breaks nonlinear Frechet regularity.
convergence_registry.redirect: Search for a weighted space satisfying the full nonlinear chart and evidence contract, not another eigenfunction.

convergence_registry.convergence: Exact per-scale Hoeffding inversion does not prove the next law admits an equivalent product reference.
convergence_registry.redirect: Prioritize a kernel characterization for product-domination preservation.

convergence_registry.convergence: Both use Fisher geometry, but vertical Markov contraction has no direct implication for independently optimized configuration histories.
convergence_registry.redirect: Require configuration construction and semiconjugacy instead of adding an invalid dependency edge.

reconciliation.issue: The diagonal embedding x maps to (x,x) refutes automatic preservation of a product-equivalent interaction reference.
reconciliation.resolution: The frozen target quantifies only over arrows satisfying the declared per-scale product-factor and domination hypotheses. The dependency DAG makes interaction-gauge-domination a prerequisite rather than deriving it from Markov positivity.

reconciliation.issue: The approved design reuses the configuration coarse-map glyph already assigned to a reference-space endomorphism.
reconciliation.resolution: The claim inventory requires symbolic disambiguation. Because the design is approved, later source implementation must record an explicit design amendment before renaming; Task 1 does not silently change the design.

reconciliation.issue: The approved design's scalar tempered-mode rule is insufficient for arbitrary comparison trivializations.
reconciliation.resolution: The generalized-mode claim adds tempered distortion of the full trivialization and inverse as a release gate. This strengthens the proof obligation without asserting the theorem now.

reconciliation.issue: Positive semiconjugacy alone can collapse histories and does not equate Fisher durations.
reconciliation.resolution: Separate history-noncollapse and history-duration-relation claims are required; no dependency edge from fiber Fisher contraction directly to history semiconjugacy is present.

reconciliation.issue: The geometry memo warned against defining semiconjugacy with a definition sign.
reconciliation.resolution: The approved design snapshot already uses equality, so that proposed correction is not applicable to the current design; the ledger nevertheless release-gates the equality as a theorem obligation.
